opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight + hotel + activity, saved to notes
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search round-trip flights on Google Flights, search hotels on Booking, find a top tour on Viator, then save a trip summary note.
steps: Open Google Flights, set origin Paris, destination, and dates, search and note the price
Open Booking, enter destination and the same dates, search and open the top hotel, note its price
Open Viator, search for the landmark tour for the destination, open the top result and note its price
Open Notes, create a new note 'Trip <city> <dates>: flight ..., hotel ..., tour ...' and press Enter

opportunities.name: Compare two PyPI packages and save note
opportunities.description: For two Python packages, search each on PyPI, open its repository link to get stars and license, then save a comparison note.
steps: Search PyPI for package A, open its page, note version and date
Click the Repository/Source link, note stars and license
Open Notes and add a note 'A version date stars license vs B ...'

opportunities.name: Web feature browser support lookup and reply email
opportunities.description: Look up a web feature on caniuse and MDN, then draft a reply email to a person with the supported version and docs link.
steps: Search the feature on caniuse and check browser support version
Search the feature on MDN and open its page
Open mail compose, enter recipient, subject 'Re: <feature> in <browser>', and body with the version and MDN URL
